title: Ollie Alternatives: 6 Fresh Dog Food Picks Like Ollie - Cratejoy
summary: Looking for an Ollie alternative? Compare four fresh dog food brands by price, plan, and delivery, plus two Cratejoy treat and chew boxes.
body_markdown:
## The alternatives


Closest swap


### The Farmer’s Dog vs Ollie


[The Farmer’s Dog](https://www.thefarmersdog.com/) works the way Ollie does. It gently cooks human-grade recipes, freezes them in portioned packs, and sizes the plan from a quiz about your dog.


**Best for:** Someone happy with fresh food who wants a different company behind it.


#### What feels familiar


Pre-portioned packs, a plan built from your dog’s age, weight, and activity, and an account where you pause, rush, or delay a box.


#### What changes


The proteins are beef, chicken, turkey, and pork. Instant Fresh is a shelf-stable version you mix with water, meant for adult and senior dogs. If your dog won’t eat it, The Farmer’s Dog offers other recipes or a refund when you donate the food to a shelter.


Try it before you subscribe


### Nom Nom vs Ollie


[Nom Nom](https://www.nomnomnow.com/) cooks each meat and vegetable separately before mixing them, so you can pick out the pieces in the bowl.


**Best for:** A picky dog who needs to taste a few recipes before you commit.


#### What feels familiar


A quiz, portioned frozen packs, and recipes from board-certified veterinary nutritionists. Lamb is on the menu, as it is at Ollie.


#### What changes


There are six recipes, and you can rotate them between deliveries at no extra cost. You can also buy a Variety Pack at Chewy or Amazon, or single packs at PetSmart, with no subscription. Nom Nom refunds the first order if you ask within 30 days.


Pantry food instead of freezer packs


### Spot & Tango vs Ollie


[Spot & Tango](https://www.spotandtango.com/) sells frozen Fresh meals and UnKibble, a dry food made from human-grade ingredients cooked and dried at low heat.


**Best for:** Someone who liked Ollie’s baked recipes, or who has no freezer room.


#### What feels familiar


Food portioned to your dog from a quiz, and a plan you can pause or cancel from your account.


#### What changes


UnKibble sits in the pantry, and an open bag keeps for about eight weeks. You can’t pick both UnKibble and Fresh for one dog online, but support builds a mixed plan on request. The first order comes with a 14-day money-back trial.


No subscription at all


### JustFoodForDogs vs Ollie


[JustFoodForDogs](https://justfoodfordogs.com/) sells fresh frozen meals by the box, so you can order once and stop.


**Best for:** Someone who wants fresh food without another auto-renewing plan.


#### What feels familiar


Cooked whole-food recipes, frozen in 18 oz packs, with daily diets for puppies through seniors.


#### What changes


You pick the recipe and box size yourself instead of getting a portioned plan. Subscribe & Save is optional, with deliveries every 1 to 12 weeks and 5% off repeat orders. You can also find it at Petco, Chewy, Amazon, and the brand’s own kitchens.


Treats with a short ingredient list


### Organic Dog Treat Subscription Box vs Ollie


[Organic Dog Treat Subscription Box | Handmade Bakery Treats for Dogs](https://www.cratejoy.com/products/choose-your-subscription-plan-pawsitivelyorganicdogbakery) by PAWsitively-Organic-Dog-Bakery


From $33.00 / box


Free shipping


[Shop Now](https://www.cratejoy.com/products/choose-your-subscription-plan-pawsitivelyorganicdogbakery)


**Best for:** A dog on fresh food whose treats haven’t caught up.


PAWsitively Organic Dog Bakery bakes three or four kinds of treats for each box in its New Jersey kitchen, such as pumpkin muffins, peanut butter donuts, and decorated cookies.


#### What feels familiar


Human-grade ingredients and no corn, soy, artificial preservatives, or fillers, close to the promise on Ollie’s own recipes.


#### What changes


These are treats, not meals, so they sit next to Ollie or any fresh plan. Boxes are baked after billing and ship around the 15th of the month.


Chews and toys for a tough chewer


### PupJoy Power Chewers Box vs Ollie


[Monthly PupJoy Power Chewers Box, Treats & Toys, All Natural](https://www.cratejoy.com/products/pupjoy) by PupJoy


From $37.00 / box


Free shipping


[Shop Now](https://www.cratejoy.com/products/pupjoy)


**Best for:** A strong chewer who finishes dinner fast and wants something to work on.


PupJoy sends treats and sturdier toys, sized from Tea Cup to Huuuge, and tailors each box to the dog on your profile. It’s also a pick in our[BarkBox alternatives](https://www.cratejoy.com/blogs/box-insider/boxes-like-barkbox) , if toys matter more than treats.


#### What feels familiar


A box built around your dog’s size, on a monthly schedule.


#### What changes


It holds toys and chews, not food. Boxes ship within one business day, and shipping is free in the US and $5 to Canada.
